title: AGSoft Save Image Plus adds focus mode, bilingual tooltips, and Nodes 2.0 preview
summary: The AGSoft Save Image Plus ComfyUI custom node was updated with an image batch focus preview mode, bilingual button tooltips, and preview rendering support for the ComfyUI Nodes 2.0 interface alongside classic canvas compatibility.
research_notes:
Clone the repository into the ComfyUI custom_nodes directory using git clone https://github.com/Art-xmaster/comfyui-AGSoft.git or install comfyui-AGSoft via ComfyUI Manager.

Restart the ComfyUI server to load the custom node definitions.

Add the AGSoft Save Image Plus node to your ComfyUI workflow and connect the generated image tensor to its image input.

Configure the filename prefix and format options, then toggle focus mode to preview batch generations in either classic canvas or Nodes 2.0 interface.

Keep classic canvas mode fallback enabled if experiencing UI rendering inconsistencies in early Nodes 2.0 interface builds.

Use focus mode when generating multi-image batches to inspect individual preview frames without leaving the node graph.
